cases.name: Barbara A. Palladino
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Barbara received her MBA in Agricultural Economics & Marketing from Rutger's University in 1980 and was a stellar student and a world class researcher. One friend wrote “Barbara could get information out of a rock”.

Barbara was a research analyst for W. L. Gore & Associates for more than 20 years. After retirement in 2017, she returned to Gore as a contractor and continued providing research solutions.

Gardening was one of Barbara’s passions, but animals had a bigger place in her heart. Animal rescue work was a big part of her life. Barbara was an accomplished fundraiser for causes involving animals and the poor."
cases.narrative: He shot her multiple times in the head with a shotgun.
